title: Repeat Food-Loss Payments within 12 Months, Northgate Protect
content:
**Rule.** On a Northgate Protect Standard-tier food-loss payment, a repeat share applies to the food loss held within the per-claim food-loss limit, by the food-loss payments booked on the plan less than 12 whole months before today: the two-payment share of one half (0.5) when there are two or more, the one-payment share of 75 percent (0.75) when there is exactly one, and the whole of it when there are none.

| Food-loss payments booked on the plan less than 12 whole months before today | Share of the held food loss paid |
|---|---|
| Two or more | One half (0.5) |
| Exactly one | 75 percent (0.75) |
| None | The whole of it |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A held food loss of $200.00 with one food-loss payment booked seven months ago: 75 percent, $150.00.
- The same held amount with two payments booked in the last year: one half, $100.00.
- A payment booked 13 months ago does not count; with no other, the held amount is paid whole.
